label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived from java.util.Random.nextInt() which generates predictable pseudo-random numbers unsuitable for cryptographic purposes like session token generation. The value flows directly from the insecure source into the rememberMe cookie/session attribute. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided parameters (param from decoded cookie value OR cookie names/values) concatenated into response output strings printed via response.getWriter().println(). Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities on their respective paths.

evidence.note: java.util.Random.nextInt() generates insecure random number assigned to rememberMeKey
response.getWriter().println outputs user-controlled content concatenated with response text
